notes.title: Major Improvements! 🤩 Monthly Changelog
notes.notes:
Commanders! 

We're excited to share with you what's changed within this month in Zoria: Age of Shattering. We've implemented some elements you haven't seen before, as well as further improved features already in the game. Let's jump into it! 

⚔️ Speed Button During Encounter
Say goodbye to long, drawn-out battles. With our new speed button, you can now control the pace of your encounters. This feature adds a new level of strategy and enjoyment to our turn-based combat system. Plus, we've added a handy marker on the turn queue, so you'll always know when the turn ends.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4e010c5757dff2727441915996a85a2051185731.png
⚔️ Combat Review
Knowledge is power, and our new combat review feature gives you plenty of it. After each battle, you'll receive a summary, complete with EXP gained and any additional bonuses. And if you take on a new enemy, your journal will get updated with a new entry, which will be shown on-screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/e5e22fc466adc86cc10ad190fc8c4a7212c15e3e.png
⚔️ Partial Voice Over
We implemented a partial voice over that really breathes life into our characters. Now, characters will say the beginning of their dialogue lines, which adds a new layer of depth and personality. Hearing the voices of characters complements the storytelling aspect of Zoria, and makes them more real and dynamic. Soon, we'll show you what the voice overs actually sound like, so stay tuned!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/11e3f2a7a926854c14d3200d280454d89a58e0b2.png
⚔️ Map Improvements
Navigation just got a whole lot easier. We added checkpoints to the map and made it more user-friendly, so you can focus on the adventure at hand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be33dcff6215f8c0ff0fdae7910e3d4a8cbce136.png
⚔️ UI Improvements
Finding and managing your equipment now should be a breeze. We touched up the equipment tab for better usability - new items will now be clearly marked, so you'll never miss a new addition to your inventory.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/1f9e7c8675221ce9d43b96d7adf34cbfa979afbb.png
⚔️ Overall Quality Improvements
We worked on the overall quality of graphics in Zoria. From on-screen fonts and effects to the look of characters in and outside of cutscenes - the edges are visibly sharper. We also improved the journal with quests, making it more readable and easier to use.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3b3c72cedbdc875812978321d74d419f9770b307.png
We hope you enjoy these updates as much as we enjoyed creating them. Follow us on Twitter and join our Discord if you haven't already. Let's stay in touch! ⚔️  

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Release Date and Price Announcement
notes.notes:
Commanders!

First off, a huge thank you for your patience and ongoing support. We're super excited to let you know that our much-anticipated game, Zoria: Age of Shattering, is set to officially launch on March 7th, 2024.

[previewyoutube=6-_NIf8ELl4;full][/previewyoutube]
Okay, so here's the situation. We're a team of three developers. We showed the demo to different gaming events, organized closed on-site playtests, listened to an external QA team and after gathering all this feedback we came to the conclusion that what we have isn't what we can hand over to you in the next month.

Zoria: Age of Shattering is an ambitious project, considering the scale of our team. We would say it's very ambitious, as we are reaching nearly 300k words in the game. An extensive story is great, but we also have a ready to-do list of things that require our work. We can certainly confirm that the game is playable and we have achieved content-lock. However, the content itself is only half the success. UX, your comfort of playing, and a great focus on eliminating as many bugs and blockers as possible is our priority at the moment. In short, we want to give you a game that we're proud of.

We believe that you understand the situation and that the additional weeks of waiting will be worth it. We have prepared 30+ hours of content for you, and the best is still waiting for the reveal!

Also, you have time to finish Baldur's Gate 3, there are no excuses in March! 😉

Since we gathered you here, we'll put all the cards out on the table and reveal the price as well. 
Zoria: Age of Shattering will be available for purchase at $24.99.

Follow us on Twitter and join our Discord if you haven't already. Let's stay in touch! ⚔️  

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: About our Release Date
notes.notes:
Commanders!
We have some important news about the release of Zoria: Age of Shattering. Over the past few weeks, we've been rigorously QA testing the game to ensure it's ready for release. However, our latest tests indicate that the game will not meet our satisfaction level by October 5th. Therefore, we must delay the launch by a few weeks. 

We understand that this may be disappointing news, but we believe that taking this extra time to test and refine the game will ultimately result in a better experience for all of us. We appreciate your patience and understanding. Your anticipation and excitement for the game have been a constant source of motivation for us, and we're incredibly grateful for your support.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/8f358daac9e9cb88d2d8e91861f3110dcaf65de6.png
Fighting with bugs
For the past few weeks, we've been collaborating with an external QA team, who have reported over 280 issues to us. While most of these are minor, our small team of three people, including one programmer handling most of the issues (poor Gabi), finds this number too significant to be sure that by October 5th, we will be able to deliver a game that we can confidently deem as a finished product.

Therefore, our primary focus for the upcoming days will be intensive QA testing to determine precisely how many more weeks of additional bug fixing we require.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/fd0d1948cb7693809e54dab27d96151ac7e465b4.png
Working on balance
In addition to bug fixing, we're also working on enhancing the game's balance to provide you with a smooth experience. It involves careful adjustment of character and item stats and giving a second look at all the effects, etc.

Ultimately, thorough testing is the key to delivering a game that meets your expectations and our high standards. We still need a bit more time to finalize the game and accurately determine a new release date. Stay tuned! We are doing our best to make it worth the wait.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/84ef4923c9e37789a0ed25de41382727c2000282.png
The new demo
We recently launched a new demo, and we strongly encourage you to play it and share your feedback. A questionnaire will be available after you finish the demo, and we'd love to hear your thoughts.

In the upcoming weeks, our representatives will attend PAX West in Seattle and WASD in London. We'll demonstrate the demo and gather last-minute feedback before we wrap up production.

We are dedicated to regularly updating you on our progress. You can always find us on Discord or Twitter/X. Please keep an eye out for further news. Thank you for your continuous support and understanding. We're confident that the wait will be worth it.

Until next time, 
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Ready, Set, Upgrade! Monthly Changelog #8
notes.notes:
Commanders! ⚔️ 

We're back with some updates to get you even more excited for Zoria's upcoming release. 😃 Check out what we've got for you in this Monthly Changelog #8!  

A bit of a Story Redesign  

After consultations with an experienced and inspiring creative game director, we decided to redesign parts of the game to make it more captivating for newcomers while retaining a fair amount of references to veterans who played the Prologue and the Demo. In other words – don't worry if you haven't played any of these; we made sure that the game will be a great stand-alone experience and that you'll embark on a wonderful adventure that will gradually unfold in front of you. 😊  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/ff5326dacb70209ec8f27deab06ae0abb9d58fb9.jpg

Outposts System  

We've completed the Outposts! With Outpost System fully implemented, you'll be able to rest and recover your followers in the cozy "Moon Flower" Burrow, unleash your inner alchemist with the Black Cauldron, and visit Blacksmith's workshop for the finest of items. The "Lucky Dog" Inn will be your go-to place for thrilling quests and finding loyal companions to join your adventures. And yes, there will be an upgrade system that will allow you to enhance your outpost, but we're still figuring out the economy so that the rewards would be sufficient and satisfying – not broken. 😉  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/bd5103adbeae45bde8258f8d42041e1b04d354bd.jpg

Character Creator   

We consider the highly anticipated Character Creator system as a "feature complete," giving you a lot of elements to play with to customize your in-game persona. You'll be able to choose your gender, experiment with various hairstyles (including facial hair, such as beards and mustaches), and mix and match cloth and armor pieces to create your unique look. Tailor your character's body shape and proportions, and enhance their appearance with a wide range of tattoos, scars, makeup, and more. 🤩   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/f69926800ef6d733c9a8896ee8b838a815aaf22f.jpg

Polish  

We're just 70 days away from the big launch of our game! Our team is hard at work, polishing every aspect of the game to make sure everything runs smoothly. Your enthusiasm for Zoria have been our driving force, and we're aiming to deliver a game that exceeds your expectations. Together, we'll embark on an unforgettable journey, and we can't wait to share it with you!  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/4f764a0463984e6c7f65bc0698c25f19badb5735.jpg

Follow us on Twitter and join our Discord to stay up to date with the latest news! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png

As always, we appreciate your continuous support ❤️

Until next time,   

Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Full release on October 5th. Monthly Changelog #7
notes.notes:
Hello, Commanders!

Before we get to the changelog, let's share with you the latest decision we made.

Important Announcement

Due to the congested September release schedule, we chose to delay the release date of Zoria. Titles such as Baldur's Gate 3, Starfield, and Lies of P, to name just a few, release around the same period. While some of you have pointed it out as we announced our release date, we couldn't put Zoria, an indie game, and other AAA production titles, in the same league (but thanks to those of you who did, we took it as a huge compliment!). Long story short, we feel that shifting our release date would give Zoria the attention and exposure it deserves.

That said, we settled that October 5th will be the best day to release Zoria: Age of Shattering. It's just a few days later than our initial release date, but we believe this time will provide a space between releases needed for Zoria to shine through. ☀️ Additionally, since every single day at this point will be extremely precious, it will give us extra time to polish the game. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/0c830a31173f7ec72116407516620d9bce007d9d.jpg

Now, let's see what's changed within the past month!

Monthly Changelog

⚔️ Character Creator
One of the significant improvements we've made in this category is optimizing asset resource management, which results in a lower memory footprint at runtime, ensuring smoother gameplay. 

We also enhanced the customization options. Firstly, we improved support for colors, shader material modifications, and emissive materials. We even added a color picker! Secondly, we added a dynamic size and scale control of the human body. Thanks to that feature, you'll be able to adjust body proportions and create different shapes of faces, making each character one-of-a-kind.

Furthermore, we implemented a wide array of styling features, such as various hairstyles, faces, makeup options, eyebrows, facial hair, etc., to ensure characters will come in a wide variety. Lastly, we incorporated numerous new item models that can be used for character design, providing even more customization options. 

We started creating new NPCs using the updated character creator system, bringing more life and diversity to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/f541c4d775b4800f5aca04b2b3bacf31fe2a8cab.png

⚔️ Icon Generator
We developed a useful tool for creating icons for in-game items. We're using it to create icons for all weapons and armor pieces in the inventory. We plan on using it to create portraits for heroes made with Character Creator as well, but we're still working on that 😉

Besides that, we're reworking and adjusting the outposts to improve clarity and make them more intuitive. Some new areas and dungeons have also emerged from the shadows, but we cannot talk too much about them to avoid spoiling anything. We're also waiting for the last two background music pieces, and Zoria's soundtrack will be complete! 😁 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/bd3946dc33c37d359b1b6152f09c218cd7498297.png

That's all for now, but stay tuned for more updates!

Follow us on Twitter and join our Discord ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png

As always, we appreciate your continuous support ❤️

Until next time,
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Exotic armor, hiding trees, and the Lucky Dog Inn. Monthly Changelog #5
notes.notes:
Commanders! ⚔️

We're excited to share the latest update for Zoria: Age of Shattering. Our team has been working non-stop to bring you changes and improvements that'll make your gaming experience even better. This month we'd like to share what's new regarding camera & control systems, armor, outpost systems, and more! So, let's dive right in and see what's new 😁  

Camera and Controls  
The camera will now have a smoother motion and auto-rotation toward the movement direction. Plus, we've added alternative keyboard movement controls for those who prefer this control style to the mouse-click-only control. The camera collision system will work better now, and a new see-through camera obstruction feature will ensure an unobstructed view.  

Trees will no longer block your view! They will now disappear and won't block your sight 🌲👀  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/330efdccb0c3dd177e95e65748daaaa2b219606f.gif

Armor Tweaks  
Armor changes will be visible on the 3D models of the main character and followers! We've also categorized current armor sets into Light, Medium, Hardened, and Heavy, as well as by rarity: Common, Uncommon, Rare, Exotic, and Epic. We'll add even more armor designs in future updates. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/aba9aea71d4ba230863e4fe22a5b61b597367165.png

Outposts System  
We've added a couple of new outposts in the game, e.g., the "Lucky Dog Inn" and the "Moon Flower Burrow." The "Lucky Dog Inn" will be your go-to spot for quests and recruiting followers, while the "Moon Flower Burrow" will be perfect for resting and recovering 😊  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/abbc6701200d8344eb55b25187b6e65dacd60cc8.png

Difficulty Settings  
There's a new system that will let you choose the difficulty of the game. This will affect things like Enemy HP, Enemy stats influencing damage and resistances, and Enemy abilities. We decided on three classic levels of gameplay difficulty: Easy, Normal, and Hard. Pick whichever suits you best!  


Additionally, Neles – Zoria's Producer and Quest Writer - is currently representing Tiny Trinket games at the Reboot Develop Blue in Dubrovnik, meeting with other game developers, exchanging experiences, and of course, introducing Zoria to a new public 😊   

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/1d417d7cc18fd1a177cf84a9a4b9cb0d66d751b7.png

Keep your fingers crossed for Neles, and as always, follow Zoria on Twitter and Facebook, and join the Discord server to make sure you get all the latest updates and news from the world of Zoria! ⚔️

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d029a793af54184beabe368f4d69a5d886e66078.png

Until next time!  
Tiny Trinket Games

notes.title: Luring Dragons, Spawning Elementals, Counting Skulls. Monthly Changelog #2
notes.notes:
Hello, Commander!

Working on Zoria: Age of Shattering is an exciting but also challenging experience. The ideas are endless, and expectations - yours and ours - are high. This month we introduced many valuable changes to the game. Are you ready? Welcome to Monthly Changelog #2! ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/317b055d31d32918383f57710c9d3fcd342e7cd5.png
A party ready to explore each corner. Do I smell... chest?!

Remodeled and expanded locations

Rithvale had a complete makeover. We needed to rebuild it to match it with our current level of quality. Rithvale will become your homebase and your safe haven you'll long for after a long journey. 

Players will now have quests available (both sidequests and main quests), making it a more lively area worth revisiting at different stages of the game. 

Do you remember Shrieking Pass? Some of you might have seen it in the demo from 2 years ago. We felt this location could be more interesting, so we decided to revisit it, with some new places and adventures ːsteamhappyː Now it is not only an area where the story takes place but also a part of the story on its own.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/49dbdd63e06bb600173d0916c5c6d527ef4be3a2.png
This is totally how we rebuilt our locations. We evacuate everyone, and then we lure a dragon and four Trolls to raze the city to the ground. Easy-peasy.

Attacks of Opportunity

RPG players are most likely familiar with this system. Certain characters will be able to strike an enemy unit in combat as it moves next to them. It can be a very satisfying move that'll prevent your opponents from running away from you and has a significant chance to finish them off without the need to chase them around the map (and possibly get into a trap).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/b63fcea7cee1ac627cfd67196287b48dfb292524.png
These water elementals have yet to realize that they should be running away.

Character Creator

Character Creator was a Strech Goal on Kickstarter that we unfortunatelly didn't reached BUT we decided to add it after all. ːsteammockingː We believe that creating your own character in an RPG adds a lot of value to a roleplaying aspect of the game. Whether you like to adjust a gender or look to your own for a better immersion, play a hero of your dreams or make it an honor to play as a female character whenever possible - we've got you.

Once again, huge thanks to everyone who supported us in the Kickstarter campaign!ːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/fea9a90ae26d6849e8e11143412fed62385c104a.png
There was a crowd waiting to witness your glory, but you took too long to pick up that perfect shade of hair (even though you can't see it through the helmet).

Best Upcoming - IndieDB Indie of the Year 2022

Do you remember how last time we asked you to vote in a IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll...? 

We got the 5th place!!! ːsteamhappyː

We knew there were a lot of you out there, yet getting this high in the rank exceeded our expectations! Thank you so much for voting! It wouldn't be possible without your helpːsteamhappyː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/3d420c801c7d7b64fb2cf4eaaf904c7d41049ee1.png

ːsteammockingː You can watch Best Upcoming - IndieDB Indie of the Year 2022 here:

[previewyoutube=08qYfucW5XI;full][/previewyoutube]

That's it for now ːsteammockingː

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/e892b0502d64710e3823e006f2262b7f2d8902ec.png
You see a path that leads you forward. The path has been lit by a dozen of torches and adorned with skulls impaled on stakes. Someone passed this way not long ago.


ːsteammockingː If you want to connect with the community, you can join Zoria's Discord here:

notes.title: What's new in the world of Zoria? Monthly changelog.
notes.notes:
Hello commanders! 

It's been almost a month and a half since our Kickstarter, and during this time, we're working up a sweat to deliver the game that will give you a ton of fun. We want to introduce you to what we are currently developing and show you some new screenshots. We hope you enjoy them and whet your appetite for more! 

But before we get to the main course, we'd like to ask you to vote for Zoria in IndieDB's Indie of the Year poll. There are many of you out there, and we believe that together we will rank high in this competition for indie game lovers. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/070d9a93bf60633e767eed8a809110243b4bbfd7.jpg

You can cast a vote on our IndieDB page >>here<< 

Now, let's move on with the changelog.

Nightwarden Class
As some of you may recall, one of the secret goals of the Kickstarter campaign was reaching 50%, and it unlocked a new class - fearless and violent Nightwarden. First, we had some rough ideas on how this class should act on the battlefield, and during the last month, we managed to finish the profile of this class.

Nightwardens will use fire on the battlefield because this is the most effective deterring of monsters. Having Nightwarden in your team will significantly increase the group morale, as Nightwardens fear no death and can teach their teammates how to act the same. On top of that, Nightwardens know that the night is short; therefore, they must act quickly. 

https://i.ibb.co/Tbwhbsn/Sequence-01.gif

Day-night cycle
Well, what would be the point of the existence of Nightwardens if there were no night, wasn't it? That's why we've been spending the last few weeks polishing the day and night cycle in the world of Zoria, which will not only limit the amount of sunlight but also affect certain events and behaviors at specific times of the day. 

And remember, the world of Zoria is not a safe enough place during the day. I dread to think how it will be at night. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/93915a48baa4f2479e17f23caf1e3c518aa83b44.png

Lake Mannor
A castle in the middle of rocky mountains, a fisherman's hut, fog hovering over the lake, and rumors of a secret lurking beneath the surface of this reservoir. Don't forget to chat with a hunter who stays in the area, as he will have something to say about the place. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/be8af7db7561bac19c67085c8531cdf6aea06404.png

New enemy - Troll
What is it - it has two legs, pointy ears, smells horrible, and you wouldn't entrust your pet to its care? No, it's not a green-clad boy rescuing a princess. It's a nasty troll lurking for fresh meat, inattentively straying near his lair. Just look at this monstrosity. It's probably time to show him that treating poor animals like this doesn't seem right. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/d82af1487ef059090674bc53069b9c4c76b038c5.png

That's all for today, and we're back to making the game. Let us know what you think of the above features, and don't forget to join our Discord - it's a smug place for RPG & coffee lovers (but if you are more of a tea person, you are more than welcome too.) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35921056/329fdb66137bcd2c299ca4d231619a03b531062d.png

And if you haven't played the latest demo yet, be sure to test it out. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/

Stay tuned,
Zoria Team

notes.title: Update 0.3.5 coming June 29th
notes.notes:
Greetings adventurers of Zoria,

With all the great feedback we have received from you following the Prologue launch, we now have ready an update that introduces a number of changes and additions to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other issues and requests.

This update will go live Monday, 8AM PDT. 

Unfortunately, due to the extensive interventions we have made on the game, the existing saves are not compatible with this update. We are aware this might be unpleasant for a number of players but, weighting the pros and cons we think it’s better to make all these updates available to everyone.

This incompatibility is due to extensive changes made to the database and the interactions system powering the game.

Below a list of the major updates and fixes:

Updated Combat UI: a consistent update to the combat UI, with far more information for the player: Line of Sight indicators for all enemies in range when moving to a new position, on the ground indicators for motion range and AP consumed, available abilities when moving to a new position and many more small improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/cb7704cfbe9f015f3244f1a807b607bb8de6bf44.png 

•	Hovering the mouse over the battlefield will show the Action Points consumed for moving to that position and the enemies in line of sight from that position.
•	The abilities shown above each enemy will be grayed out if the character will not have enough resources to use them once in position.
•	Hovering the mouse over the character will show the enemies in line of sight from the current position and the abilities available to use. The abilities can be selected either with the mouse or with the number keys 1-9.
Based on feedback we also implemented click-to-move by default and also, clicking on an enemy that is in range will attack that enemy with the default attack.

Formations: Another very popular request, formations are now fully implemented in the game. There are 4 fixed formations and 3 completely custom formations. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/e88eec02454f333f042444374ff19f6753ad3044.png

In the formations screen, the Captain is always in the center, as a fixed position. 
For the fixed formations, the followers can be distributed in the available slots, but the slots are fixed.
For the custom formations, all the slots except the Captain slot can be moved freely, allowing the player to make any kind of setup desired. 
 
Updated Compendium: Improve Bestiary, with a more granular representation of all the enemies encountered in-game. After the first combat with a new enemy, the information is unlocked in the bestiary part of the Compendium, with some lore about that type of enemy and important data about fighting that enemy – Strengths (physical, magical resistances), Weaknesses and Threat level.
All enemies encountered in the game are now represented in the Compendium.

Fixed multiple issues in quest-design: we have fixed a number of quest events that in certain edge case situations would not trigger properly. 

Fixed multiple UI issues: we have made small changes to the UI based on existing feedback, fixed a few minor bugs and made some small changes to improve readability.

Text edits and fixes: we fixed some typos that managed to escape proofreading in the previous builds.

Encounters balancing: we have decided to take another look at the Guardian encounter and balance the fight to be more accessible and fix some unavoidable damage that could one-shot a follower. Since difficulty levels are not yet implemented, we have rebalanced this fight to be more accessible to players of all skill levels, allowing everyone to see the entire Prologue.

With all this said, there is still much feedback from you that is being worked, together with the rest of the systems still to be introduced to the game - Crafting, Alchemy, Cooking and the whole Outpost base and followers management system.


If you enjoy this Prologue, come follow us here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1159090/Zoria_Age_of_Shattering/

If you like the game and want to follow its development, you can also join our Discord:
 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37113177/19d7859b4b198674e9889887d5720324d8ae3470.jpg

notes.title: Patch 0.3.1 is now LIVE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We want to thank you all for the awesome feedback we received in these past few days. Based on this feedback we implemented a number of changes to the game, aimed mostly at quality of life and other small issues that could be fixed in a timely manner.


 Adjusted Captain’s resistance to poison to prevent him from being destroyed by the spiders in the caves.
 “New skill points” display error on level up has been fixed. Now properly displays “New stat points”.
 A few spelling errors than went undiscovered during testing have now been fixed .
 Some quest dialogues that were not as clear as we would have liked them to have been adjusted.
 Fixed an issue with the order in which the enemies were entering a combat, causing them to be higher up in queue than designed.
 The special resource used by the followers has been unified under one name: Focus.
 Followers keep basic movement formation when entering the combat. More formations options will be implemented later.
 Anya/Emonora higher starting level (3/4) to make the experience in the dungeon more enjoyable.
 Fixed Area-of-Effect targeting for some enemies.
 Updated Health Bar UI to green for friendly and red for enemy units.
